test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If 4 lines of a print, in a column of a book, contain 63 words, how many words will a column of 52 lines contain?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Words ∝ Lines

4 lines → 63 words ⇒ 1 line → 63/4 words

52 lines → 52 × (63/4)

= 13 × 63 = 819

**∴ Answer = 819 words**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

4 lines contain 63 words

Required: words in 52 lines

**Formula used:**

Direct proportion ⇒ Words = (New lines × Words₁) ÷ Lines₁

**Calculation:**

⇒ Words = (52 × 63) ÷ 4

⇒ = (13 × 63)

⇒ = 819

**∴ The correct answer is 819 words.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Direct Proportion

If lines increase, words increase proportionally

Unitary Method

Find value of one unit, then multiply

Simplification Tip

Cancel numbers before multiplying

Key Idea

Use ratio form: (52/4) × 63

29
